plan.title: Reject Counter Offer on Non-Negotiable GST

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with the relevant bids on the Responses tab.
Enable the counter-offer UI for RFQs.
Ensure the RFQ project flow is enabled.
Open the bid comparison grid where the buyer can initiate a counter offer.

args.goal: On the buyer's Master QCS, open the counter offer for Vendor A's normal bid, change only the non-negotiable GST column, submit the counter offer, and stop when the screen shows the refusal.

steps.note: The catalog's place_counter_offer step cannot select GST specifically, so perform the required column-level action directly on the buyer screen.

args.text: You cannot give a counter offer on these columns.
